datasets.summary: LAUS produces monthly and annual employment, unemployment, and labor force estimates for states, counties, metropolitan areas, and cities by place of residence.

datasets.name: Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS)
datasets.summary: BRFSS is a survey that collects health-related risk behaviors, chronic health conditions, and use of preventive services.

datasets.name: CDC Epidemic Trends and Rt
datasets.summary: Weekly estimates of the effective reproduction number (Rt) for COVID-19, Influenza, and RSV at the US national and state level. Rt represents the average number of secondary infections generated by one infectious person. Values above 1 indicate growth; below 1 indicate decline.

datasets.name: NCHS VSRR Provisional Maternal Death Counts and Rates
datasets.summary: Provisional national-level maternal death counts, live births, and maternal mortality rate from NCHS's Vital Statistics Rapid Release program.

datasets.name: 2020 Census Urban Area to County Allocation File
datasets.summary: Demographic, social, economic, housing, and land use data at the ZIP code and county level. They are supplemented with data from the American Community Survey (ACS), a survey of households in the United States conducted by the Census Bureau.

datasets.name: Mapping Medicare Disparities by Population Tool
datasets.summary: These data are generated from the Mapping Medicare Disparities (MMD) by Population Tool, which displays data on displays chronic disease prevalence, costs, hospitalization, and preventive care utilization data for Medicare Fee-for-Service beneficiaries.

datasets.name: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps
datasets.summary: The County Health Rankings & Roadmaps (CHR&R) program, a collaboration between the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation and the University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute, ranks the health of nearly all counties in the nation.

datasets.name: CMU Delphi COVIDcast - Doctor Visits
datasets.summary: The Delphi Doctor Visits signal estimates the percentage of outpatient doctor visits with COVID-related diagnoses based on claims data from health system partners.

files.dataset_stratification: Outpatient doctor visits with COVID-related diagnoses.

datasets.name: CMU Delphi COVIDcast - Hospital Admissions
datasets.summary: The Delphi Hospital Admissions signal estimates the percentage of new hospital admissions with COVID-19 or influenza diagnoses based on electronic medical records and claims data from health system partners.

files.dataset_stratification: Hospital admissions with respiratory virus-related diagoses

datasets.name: CMU Delphi Epidata - FluView (ILINet)
datasets.summary: Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) surveillance data from the CDC's ILINet network, accessed via the CMU Delphi Epidata API. ILINet is a collaborative effort between the CDC, state and local health departments, and approximately 3,000 outpatient healthcare providers across the United States. Providers report the total number of patients seen and the number presenting with ILI (defined as fever >=100F plus cough and/or sore throat without a known cause other than influenza).

datasets.name: CMU Delphi COVIDcast - NHSN Respiratory Hospitalizations
datasets.summary: Weekly hospital respiratory data reported to CDC's National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN), accessed via the CMU Delphi Epidata API. NHSN collects data from hospitals across the United States on COVID-19, influenza, and RSV associated hospital admissions.

datasets.name: Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy (CHAS) data
datasets.summary: CHAS data is a custom tabulation of American Community Survey data produced for HUD, providing detailed cross-tabulations of housing problems (cost burden, overcrowding, and facilities adequacy) by income, tenure, and race, at multiple geographic levels including county.

datasets.name: Kinsa Insights API
datasets.summary: The share of Kinsa smart thermometer users reporting cough, cold, or influenza-related illness (ILI) symptoms. These data are collected by Kinsa through its companion mobile app. Users who record a temperature reading are asked about accompanying symptoms.

datasets.name: CDC Measles Cases and Outbreaks - Age and Vaccination Status
datasets.summary: Weekly new and cumulative case and hospitalization counts for measles in the United States by age and vaccination status.

files.dataset_stratification: Measles cases by age and vaccination status

datasets.name: CDC Measles Cases and Outbreaks
datasets.summary: Confirmed and probable measles cases reported to CDC by state and local health departments.

datasets.name: Johns Hopkins University Measles Tracking Team
datasets.summary: Laboratory-confirmed measles case data from official state and county health department reports across the United States compiled by the Johns Hopkins Measles Tracking Team.

datasets.name: Medicaid and CHIP Adult and Child Core Set Quality Measures
datasets.summary: Health care access and quality measures for Medicaid and CHIP beneficiaries across behavioral, maternal, primary and preventive, dental, and chronic disease care. Reporting is voluntary; not all states report all measures each year.

datasets.name: HealthMap MMR Vaccine Coverage Estimates
datasets.summary: Estimates of measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage among children in the United States.

datasets.name: National Immunization Survey (NIS)
datasets.summary: The National Immunization Surveys (NIS) monitors vaccination coverage among children 19-35 months, teens 13-17 years, flu vaccinations for children 6 months-17 years, and COVID-19 vaccination for children, teens, and adults.

datasets.name: National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS)
datasets.summary: The NNDSSS collects reports of notifiable diseases, including measles, cyclosporiasis, arboviruses, sexually transmitted infectious, hepatitus, and other infections.

datasets.name: NOAA WPC HeatRisk
datasets.summary: The NOAA Weather Prediction Center HeatRisk provides a daily score for heat risk across the United States for the current day and 7-day forecast period.

datasets.name: National Respiratory and Enteric Virus Surveillance System (NREVSS)
datasets.summary: The  NREVSS is a voluntary, laboratory-based surveillance system that monitors RSV, human parainfluenza viruses, respiratory adenoviruses, human metapneumovirus, human coronaviruses, and rotavirus in the United States.

datasets.name: National Syndromic Surveillance Program (NSSP)
datasets.summary: The NSSP records the percentage of emergency department patient visits for RSV, flu, and COVID-19.

datasets.name: Respiratory Virus Hospitalization Surveillance Network (RESP-NET)
datasets.summary: RESP-NET monitors laboratory-confirmed hospitalizations within participating hospitals associated with influenza, COVID-19, and RSV among children and adults.

datasets.name: Washington Post School Vaccination Rates
datasets.summary: School and county-level vaccination rate data compiled by the Washington Post from state health department records.

datasets.name: SchoolVaxView
datasets.summary: SchoolVaxView monitors vaccination coverage among U.S. school-aged children. Data are collected annually by states, territories, and select local jurisdictions through school vaccination assessments, which review student vaccination records at kindergarten entry.

datasets.name: Food Environment Atlas
datasets.summary: The Food Environment Atlas assembles county-level statistics on food environment indicators, including store/restaurant availability, food and nutrition assistance programs, food insecurity, and food access.

files.dataset_stratification: Overall; no stratification beyond time and geography.

datasets.name: Medical Exemptions From Childhood Vaccination in the US (Kiang et al. 2025)
datasets.summary: Data from a study of measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine exemption rates among U.S. kindergartners from 2009-2024, published in JAMA by Kiang et al.

datasets.name: CDC National Wastewater Surveillance System (NWSS)
datasets.summary: The NWSS monitors SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A, and RSV levels in wastewater across the United States. Wastewater surveillance provides population-level data on pathogen circulation regardless of whether individuals seek healthcare or testing.

datasets.name: CDC National Wastewater Surveillance System (NWSS) - Measles
datasets.summary: The NWSS was expanded in 2025 to track measles virus RNA in wastewater samples from participating wastewater treatment facilities across the United States. Wastewater surveillance detects viral shedding in a community regardless of healthcare-seeking behavior.

datasets.name: Web-based Injury Statistics Query and Reporting System (WISQARS)
datasets.summary: WISQARS provides data on fatal and nonfatal injury, violent death, and cost of injury data.

datasets.name: CDC Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBSS)
datasets.summary: The Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBSS) is a set of school-based surveys conducted by the CDC that monitor health-related behaviors among U.S. high school students.
